visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Count that never changes
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The counter under the checkboxes stays at 0 however many boxes are ticked. The page listens for the wrong event.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: 0

solution.code: 0
solution.explanation: Event names must be spelled exactly. There is no event called changed, so the listener never runs and no error is shown. The real event is change.

checks.label: Ticking both boxes shows 2
checks.expr: (() => { var b = document.querySelectorAll('input'); b[0].click(); b[1].click(); return text('#out') === '2'; })()
